title: Titanium Plating Rack Spline
system: Electroplating Anode Baskets & Current Delivery Systems
function: Spring-loaded spline contact (V-prong) for PCB rack
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Plating Rack Spline where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Spring-loaded spline contact (V-prong) for PCB rack requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by spring-loaded spline contact (v-prong) for pcb rack and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining CP Ti for plating rack geometry
TIG welding Ti filler with SPC sampling
Pickling and passivation with SPC sampling
Continuity test <1 mOhm with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for springloaded spline contact application
inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (springloaded spline verified)
commonFailures: Contact burn at rack hook from insufficient clamp - resolved by BeCu spring contact 5N minimum force — critical for springloaded spline contact performance

faq.q: What bath chemistries is Titanium Plating Rack Spline resistant to?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti used in Titanium Plating Rack Spline resists attack in hexavalent chromium plating baths (250 g/L CrO₃), sulfuric acid anodizing (15-20% H₂SO₄), nickel sulfamate (300 g/L Ni), and cyanide-based solutions where steel racks corrode at >5 mm/month. Service life in these environments exceeds 12 months continuous immersion for springloaded spline contact.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Plating Rack Spline orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Plating Rack Spline is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Plating Rack Spline?
faq.a: Each Titanium Plating Rack Spline shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for springloaded spline contact.
